findings: The public ln, exp/expm1 and inverse-hyperbolic routes can build or warm descendants during construction. The frozen composed corpus records this ordinary setup and separately reconstructs each root; its explicit allowances start only for queries.
Computable::ln_1p is crate-private. All seven new roots use public add/ln/expm1/exp/inverse-hyperbolic operations, with no private wrapper or forged serialized node.

The existing exp/log relation recognizer already requires independent operand existence before canceling a logarithm of an exponential. The new invalid-descendant corpus preserves this requirement through seven complete public compositions.

BoundInfo::planning_msd, known_msd and known_sign already have checked production contracts imported by the conditional proof target. available_bound_proves_domain currently combines those results in an unverified Computable method.

The verification target directly includes production bounds.rs, but it only imports pure codecs from representation.rs. Cached-bound producers, atomic publication loops, ownership, graph existence and caller preconditions remain outside that proof boundary.
next_priority: Bind the retained magnitude-domain predicate to an included production proof contract, preserving its exact behavior and the separate independent-existence requirement. Extract a pure BoundInfo predicate and domain tag only if needed to share the actual production body with the existing verifier; do not present a copied model as an implementation proof.
required_evidence: Freeze the v1754 runtime and the new v1755/v1757 public corpora before editing production or proof sources.

Prove the pure predicate returns exactly the intended typed decision for all bound states/domain tags, and connect accepted decisions to real-domain denotation conditional on an independently valid incoming bound and real operand.

Cover zero, unavailable exponents, inexact upper bounds, exact positive lower binades, signed exponent limits and strict/non-strict domain distinctions; reject mutations that accept an upper bound as a lower bound or admit probability zero.
Keep atomic-cache validity, existence producers, traversal/caller preconditions and all thirteen whole-crate obligation groups explicitly open where not proved.

Run the pinned complete proof target with --no-cheating, relevant rejection/acceptance guards, proportional runtime and public replay checks, and unchanged cost controls. A proof-only improvement cannot justify an empirical runtime regression under the fixed acceptance baseline.
remaining_requirements: The 522-case public composed corpus is finite, near-zero/exact-zero and sequential. Large-argument reduction, other kernels, cancellation-signal schedules and general concurrent behavior remain broader requirements.
Continue constructor, logarithm factoring, quadratic-tower/Laurent coefficient work and native/full-board combination/admission without changing full-size fixtures or earlier cost failures.
All 39 properties, 14 targets and crate future work remain in scope; all existing statuses, including the three verified targets, stay unchanged.
